title: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari guildmaster who is compleated and leads a Phyrexian legion against Ravnica, while a hidden part of her mind clings to her memories of Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who enters Vraska's mind, forgives her and gives her one last do-over, while his past scars are noted.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: The Izzet guildmaster, a planeswalker who strikes Vraska with a device attuned to Phyrexian oil; he narrates the aftermath.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: Ral's partner, who flies in on a gargoyle and later sits with him amid the ruins.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who charges Vraska with leading the invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: Ludmilla
entities.description: The other gorgon in Vraska's youth prison cell, who is killed by an Azorius guard while comforting the Golgari prisoners.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon whom Vraska remembers as the only one who trusted her to lead.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon whose seat in the Chamber of the Guildpact the Phyrexians destroy.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A Ravnican official whose office desk is seen in the exposed Chamber of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Vraska thinks of when kissing Jace.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A mage whose mind-magic scarred Jace in the past.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who compleate Ravnica's citizens, particularly the Golgari, and blind the population.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of rot and death that Vraska leads and which is largely compleated.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of law whose Senate building is destroyed and whose guards imprisoned Vraska.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of mages led by Ral Zarek, many of whom are blinded.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of unity whose warriors fight in the undercity.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose skyship and soldiers resist the invasion.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose bankers flee the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose biomancers volunteer for the oil.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-run city plane that Vraska leads the Phyrexians to raze.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The mighty Phyrexian tree whose branches break into Ravnica and carry Vraska's forces.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: The center of Ravnican law, whose roof the Phyrexians destroy.

entities.name: Golgari undercity
entities.description: The Golgari realm beneath Ravnica, home of Korozda the maze and the cathedral of Svogthos.

entities.name: Vraska's old apartment
entities.description: A small undercity flat filled with trinkets from other planes where Vraska recovers her memories of Jace.

entities.name: Thaumatic compass
entities.description: A silver object Jace and Vraska used, which she keeps in her pocket and which points at Ral.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: Phyrexian transformation that turns Vraska to metal and floods her with oil.

entities.name: The War of the Spark
entities.description: The earlier war on Ravnica when Vraska reopened the memory of Jace.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The jungle plane where Vraska and Jace shared a boat trip.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: Vraska's ship on which she and Jace once stayed.

events.summary: Vraska narrates being compleated: her throat and tendrils turn to metal, she petrifies Phyrexian agents until she is overwhelmed, and her self retreats into a hidden corner of her mind.
events.quote: I writhed and arched my back as Phyrexian oil rushed past my teeth.

events.summary: Vraska rides a Realmbreaker branch down over Ravnica as general for Elesh Norn and has it plunge through the Azorius Senate.
events.quote: I choose the simplest one and order a branch to dive straight through its center.

events.summary: Vraska's forces land at the prison where she was held, triggering a memory of her imprisonment at seventeen.
events.quote: It is the prison I was held in, the prison I tried, and succeeded, in escaping

events.summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
events.quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.

events.summary: Vraska has Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards, and orders the blinded forced to the Transguild Promenade as an example.
events.quote: "Lead them to the Transguild Promenade as an example of what we do to the unjust."

events.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people into Phyrexians while Realmbreaker upends Korozda and cracks Svogthos.
events.quote: It is a hive in the truest sense, all pieces of a single purpose.

events.summary: Vraska recalls singing with Jace on a boat on Ixalan.
events.quote: It is night on Ixalan, and I sing to the vast and buzzing jungle.

events.summary: Vraska's forces transform her subjects and defeat Selesnyan warriors in the undercity.
events.quote: a cohort of Selesnyan warriors tear through a hole in the maze

events.summary: Vraska enters her old apartment and finds the thaumatic compass, recalling the days before the War of the Spark when she reopened her memories of Jace.
events.quote: It is the weeks before the War of the Spark

events.summary: Vraska sees Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona flying over Ravnica and feels jealousy.
events.quote: Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona approach, flying close on the back of a gargoyle.

events.summary: Vraska orders her compleated Golgari to spill oil and blind the populace, leaving citizens collapsed in terror in the streets.
events.quote: "Spill as much glistening oil on the streets as you can,"

events.summary: Vraska's forces destroy the roof of the Chamber of the Guildpact and Niv-Mizzet's seat.
events.quote: delighting in crushing Niv-Mizzet's seat

events.summary: Vraska welcomes curious Simic and Izzet volunteers while others flee in terror.
events.quote: I motion to welcome them.

events.summary: Ral Zarek fights through Phyrexian ranks to reach Vraska, and hits her sternum with a cylindrical device attuned to Phyrexian oil.
events.quote: in one boxer's punch he plants it right on my sternum and hits a button.

events.summary: Vraska collapses, her broken body is deserted by her forces, and Ral walks away apologizing.
events.quote: My forces do not stay long enough for me to argue my case

events.summary: Vraska lies dying beneath rubble, half-flesh and half-metal, awaiting death.
events.quote: Now, I close my eyes and wait for the death Phyrexia promised I would never face alone.

events.summary: In her mind Vraska meets Jace at a café, remembers luring and betraying him, and tells him she deserves to die; he lets her share her memory.
events.quote: I betrayed him. I transformed him.

events.summary: Jace forgives Vraska and tells her the part that led the invasion was not her, entering the corner of her mind he made.
events.quote: "The you that kissed me wasn't you.

events.summary: Vraska and Jace share a kiss on a dreamed beach, a do-over, and Jace tells her he loves her too before a white light erupts.
events.quote: "I love you, too, captain."

events.summary: Two days after the invasion, Ral learns that an officer found no sign of Vraska's body after his haemalectric switch worked.
events.quote: "There's no sign of her body, sir."

relations.quote: I haven't lived here since I became guildmaster.

relations.note: Vraska acts as a general under Norn
relations.quote: charged with purpose by Elesh Norn herself

relations.note: They exchange I love you in her dream
relations.quote: what makes me weep is realizing I forgot the first time I fell in love.

relations.note: Jace says he loves Vraska too
Ral attacks Vraska with a device
relations.quote: in one boxer's punch he plants it right on my sternum and hits a button.

relations.note: They grip hands and Tomik sits with Ral
relations.quote: Even from this distance I see them grip hands
"You're not alone my doves, I'm here, I'm here."

relations.note: Vraska remembers Bolas as trusting her to lead
relations.quote: He is the only one who ever trusted me to lead.

relations.note: An Azorius guard imprisoned and tortured her and the Golgari
relations.quote: He is an Azorius prison guard
